tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Superharmonic function from nonergodicity] 1. 9.9.2\group thurston.ch09.ergodicitySource: thurston:page-0294 If the geodesic flow is not ergodic, $M$ admits a nonconstant bounded superharmonic function.
Proof

\sketch Convergence of the critical Green-function series produces a Green function $G$ on $M$; composing with the convex bounded function $\arctan $ gives a bounded superharmonic function.

□
